tasks.AskQuestions: People often ask questions to clarify their understanding of something they don't comprehend.
tasks.BelieveInGod: Believing in God is a personal choice and does not necessarily relate to understanding something.
tasks.ExperienceJoy: Some people might experience joy when learning new things, but this is not directly related to not understanding something.
tasks.GetSick: Not understanding something does not typically cause physical illness.
tasks.TalkToEachOther: People can discuss their confusion with others to gain clarity.
